sourceTitle: On the Relations of Man to the Lower Animals
description: "On the Relations of Man to the Lower Animals" by Thomas Henry Huxley is a scientific publication written during the late 19th century. The work explores the relationship between humans and other animals, particularly focusing on the anatomical and evolutionary connections that link them, examining how these relationships impact our understanding of humanity's place in nature.
